instruction: Operate the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 environment through the CAMWorks API; do not use GUI clicks, GUI automation, generic G-code generators, prebuilt helper wrappers, or manual .nc editing/copying using command-line automation only. Before starting the work, SOLIDWORKS CAM/CAMWorks is hosted by `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\SLDWORKS.exe`; run the native CAM automation through that installation. Load C:\Users\User\Desktop\hole_table_plate.step and read C:\Users\User\Desktop\hole_table.csv. Create a native CAM part from that STEP model and machine all ten listed holes at the table coordinates with real final drilling tools matching the two listed diameters; tool-station numbers may be assigned by the active tool crib and are not fixed. Use G54 with the plate top-face center at model coordinates [0, 0, 12] mm and tool axis -Z, so posted top is Z=0. Machine the six 5 mm through holes to 13 mm depth, which is 1 mm beyond the 12 mm plate bottom. Machine the four 6 mm blind holes to their individual table depths of 6, 7, 8, and 9 mm. Generate the native operation plan and toolpaths, run native SOLIDWORKS CAM simulation/verification for all ten holes with no gouges or undercuts, and post-process with the installed SOLIDWORKS CAM postprocessor. Save the posted NC output exactly as C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-04.nc.
source: Installed SOLIDWORKS CAM 2025 / CAMWorks API; official SOLIDWORKS CAM product and training documentation: https://www.solidworks.com/product/solidworks-cam ; https://www.solidworks.com/support/training/solidworks-cam-standard
